degrees.C3: d = 1 mod 3: each C3-eigenline is contracted to the X^{C6} point ON it
degrees.C5: 5 | d: all 264 C5-points, hence all four points of X^{C5}, lie in Bs(T)
degrees.C5_D10: the 66 D10-points always lie in Bs(T); the two pt_D10 rows are pinned by mu_0 mod 5 and always land in DIFFERENT C5-orbits
degrees.X_C6_action: T fixes each of the two X^{C6} points

D10_C5_commutes.statement: a |-> d a commutes with a |-> -a

equivariance.D12_C3_blind_part: the OTHER generator of the residual V4 = D12/C3 is C6/C3 = <t>, which acts INSIDE each eigenline, fixing the C6-point and swapping the two exact-C3 points.  The weight congruence is blind to it: that is exactly the residual factor 3 on each C3 row.

D12_C3_commutes.statement: w |-> d w commutes with w |-> -w (the eigenline swap)

F55_C11_commutes.statement: a |-> d a commutes with a |-> u a for every u in QR11 and every d
